_comment: MINIMAL — a worktree, symlinks and a port. No database, no containers.
Copy to .worktree.json in your repo root and edit `project`.
Use this when the repo has no database of its own, or when you are happy
for every worktree to share one. Nothing here can destroy shared data,
which is exactly why it is the safe starting point.
symlinks are per-worktree links back to the main checkout, for things too
big or too local to copy. Omit the key entirely to get the default set
